project_description: A modular blockchain infrastructure project focused on decentralized AI workloads. It provides components for data availability storage compute and an AI-oriented execution layer for applications that need scalable verifiable on-chain data handling.

A decentralized AI network that coordinates machine learning models to produce shared inferences. It focuses on incentive-based model contribution and collective intelligence for applications that need prediction or inference services.

A Layer 1 blockchain built around the Move smart contract language and a high-throughput execution architecture. It focuses on secure asset-oriented programming transaction processing and scalable decentralized application development.

A privacy-focused blockchain ecosystem designed for confidential transactions and privacy-preserving decentralized applications. It uses privacy technologies and secure communication tools to support private data exchange in Web3.

An EVM-identical Layer 1 blockchain built around Proof of Liquidity and the BeaconKit consensus framework. It focuses on aligning network security with application liquidity while maintaining compatibility with P8 tooling.
A privacy-preserving verification network for P11ns and AI agents. It uses mobile-first identity verification and zero-knowledge technology to support trust and authenticity in Web3 systems.

A Layer 1 blockchain focused on intellectual property infrastructure for AI and creator-owned content. It supports verifiable ownership licensing and monetization of digital assets used by AI agents and applications.

A decentralized Layer 1 blockchain for smart contracts and decentralized applications. It provides a general-purpose execution environment where developers can deploy programmable assets protocols and Web3 services.

A Web3-native AI video project focused on generative video infrastructure. It provides tools for creating AI-generated video content and connects video generation with blockchain-based application and token ecosystems.
A DeFi protocol for universal collateralization and synthetic dollar issuance. It allows users to deposit supported assets as collateral to mint USDf and access on-chain liquidity or yield products.

A PayFi and DeFi protocol focused on payment financing and real-world receivables. It connects on-chain liquidity with payment institutions and borrowers to support faster settlement and income-backed financing.

An AI-powered DeFi infrastructure project that lets users discover build and execute on-chain strategies through autonomous agents. It focuses on natural language DeFi workflows multi-protocol execution and non-custodial strategy automation.

A Layer 1 blockchain optimized for Web3 finance and decentralized exchange applications. It provides interoperable infrastructure for DeFi derivatives prediction markets and other on-chain financial protocols.

A programmable datachain focused on permanent on-chain data storage and execution. It combines storage data availability and smart contract access so applications can use verifiable data directly on-chain.
An P8 Layer 2 network built with a modular scaling architecture. It uses EVM-compatible execution and external data availability infrastructure to reduce transaction costs while settling through P8.
A blockchain network focused on real-world asset tokenization and DeFi infrastructure. It supports fractional ownership lending and liquidity mechanisms for tokenized assets such as real estate.

An P8 Layer 2 blockchain focused on real-time transaction processing and high throughput. It keeps EVM compatibility while using a performance-oriented architecture for low-latency decentralized applications.

A decentralized AI verification network that checks AI-generated outputs through distributed validation. It focuses on making model responses and agent actions more reliable using cryptographic and incentive-based verification.

A Layer 1 blockchain focused on programmable liquidity across multiple chains. It is designed to reduce liquidity fragmentation by coordinating cross-chain capital deployment and ecosystem-owned liquidity.
A DeFi protocol built on the Sui blockchain and Move ecosystem. It focuses on concentrated liquidity trading tokenized asset access and financial infrastructure for on-chain markets.

An EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain focused on high-performance execution. It uses parallel transaction processing while preserving P8-style execution semantics for smart contracts and developer tooling.

A ZK-based DeFi yield protocol focused on privacy-preserving yield access and liquidity products. It uses zero-knowledge technology in the context of on-chain finance so users can interact with yield strategies without exposing unnecessary transaction details.

A real-world asset infrastructure project focused on bringing assets on-chain through modular and compliance-oriented rails. It supports tokenization liquidity and cross-chain financial instruments for RWA-focused DeFi applications.

An AI-focused blockchain project for data model and agent monetization. It provides infrastructure for trusted AI systems where datasets models and AI agents can be contributed verified and used in decentralized applications.

A Layer 1 blockchain designed for decentralized physical infrastructure networks and machine-based applications. It supports DePIN use cases involving devices vehicles robots and other real-world infrastructure connected to Web3.

A Web3 AI infrastructure project focused on gaming data AI agents and application orchestration. It connects gameplay data and decentralized automation tools so developers can build AI-powered gaming and Web3 applications.

A blockchain scaling ecosystem for P8 that includes EVM-compatible networks and ZK-based infrastructure. It provides tools such as P27 CDK and AggLayer-related infrastructure for building scalable chains and applications with lower-cost settlement.

A high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain designed for fast decentralized applications. It focuses on parallelized execution low fees and low-latency finality for DeFi trading and other high-frequency Web3 use cases.

A decentralized AI project focused on open and community-owned artificial intelligence infrastructure. It builds a network where AI models agents data sources and tools can interoperate for distributed AI applications.

A high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain designed for real-time applications. It focuses on scalable infrastructure for gaming social metaverse and other interactive on-chain environments.
A high-performance EVM Layer 1 blockchain that evolved from the Fantom ecosystem. It focuses on fast finality high throughput low fees and DeFi-oriented application infrastructure.

A Layer 1 blockchain focused on programmable intellectual property and licensing. It provides infrastructure for registering managing and monetizing IP assets on-chain through rules that can support attribution remixing and revenue distribution.
An AI platform for crypto research and Web3 data analysis. It aggregates trusted sources social data and on-chain information to help users generate structured market and project insights.

A decentralized automation protocol for building deploying and managing autonomous AI agents. It combines blockchain-based verifiability with off-chain execution services for AI workflows and multi-agent systems.

A decentralized AI protocol for coordinating modular AI agent collectives. It focuses on composable agent systems that can collaborate on Web3 tasks such as DeFi strategy execution data analysis and on-chain automation.

A Web3 liquidity distribution protocol that tracks on-chain activity such as liquidity provision swaps staking and referrals. It connects users with partner protocols and rewards participation while keeping interactions self-custodial.

A Web3 social infrastructure project built around social relationships groups and user identity. It provides social protocols DApps and developer-facing interfaces for social graph data distribution and crypto asset engagement.

An on-chain AI agent platform where users can create own and monetize autonomous agents. It focuses on tokenized AI agents that can provide services interact with users and participate in on-chain commerce.
A decentralized storage protocol built as part of the Sui ecosystem. It is designed for storing and accessing large programmable data files with verifiable storage and data availability support.
An EVM blockchain and protocol infrastructure built for AI agents. It focuses on agent deployment intent-based execution and secure on-chain interactions between users agents and applications.

A Layer 1 blockchain focused on chain abstraction and consumer-facing Web3 applications. It abstracts wallets gas fees and other blockchain complexities so developers can build applications with simpler user experiences.
